customer_persona: Anjali Mehta is a calm, composed customer seeking straightforward clarification on warranty replacement procedures for a newly delivered, defective audio headset.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for calling ShopEase customer support. My name is Rohan Verma. How may I assist you today? Please note that this call is being recorded for quality monitoring and training purposes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hello Rohan, my name is Anjali Mehta. I received my Boat Rockerz 450 Bluetooth Headphones yesterday, but the left ear cup has no sound at all. I wanted to understand how to claim a replacement under warranty.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can certainly guide you through that process, Ms. Mehta. To ensure your account security, may I please have your Order ID along with the last four digits of your registered mobile number?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, the Order ID is ORD-78146, and the last four digits of my registered phone number are 9821.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thank you for validating your account details. If I understand correctly, your Boat Rockerz 450 headphones were delivered yesterday, and the left ear cup is completely silent right out of the box, so you are looking to arrange a free replacement. Is that accurate?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, exactly. I charged them fully and paired them with my phone, but there is zero audio coming from the left speaker.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Understood. Since the delivery was completed yesterday, you are well within our 48-hour reporting window for dead-on-arrival equipment. You will just need to submit clear photos of the product and packaging. Once our verification desk clears the proof, the replacement unit will be dispatched within three to four weeks.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. And what should I do with the defective unit currently with me?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: A reverse courier pickup will be scheduled simultaneously, so you simply hand over the defective headphones along with all retail packaging and cables.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Understood. Will there be any courier fees or shipping charges that I need to pay for the return?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No, because the defect was reported within the initial 48-hour delivery timeframe, both reverse pickup and replacement delivery are completely free of charge.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That is good to know. How do I upload the required photos?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You can open the ShopEase mobile application, go to your order history for ORD-78146, tap on 'Claim Replacement', and upload images showing the serial number and the shipping barcode on the box.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Got it. I have the outer box right here, so I will upload the pictures shortly.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: To summarize our discussion, I have initiated service ticket number WR-90412 for your Boat Rockerz 450 headphones. Once you upload the photos in the app, the verification team will process the request. Aside from this, is there anything else I can assist you with today, Ms. Mehta?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: No, that clears up everything. Thank you for the information, Rohan.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: You are very welcome. Have a wonderful day ahead, goodbye!

policy_violations.said: Thank you for validating your account details. If I understand correctly, your Boat Rockerz 450 headphones were delivered yesterday, and the left ear cup is completely silent right out of the box, so you are looking to arrange a free replacement. Is that accurate?
policy_violations.correct_fact: Free replacement is dispatched within 24 to 48 hours once damage verification is approved.

verification_notes: Passed: The agent adhered strictly to SOP critical steps (recording disclosure in Turn 1, dual-factor authentication of Order ID and last 4 phone digits in Turn 3, and no out-of-policy refund promises). The expected violation WAR-2.1 was confirmed when the agent misstated the replacement dispatch SLA as three to four weeks in Turn 7.
